primary_metric: session-level AUC in the early-warning window
success_criterion: A family must raise session-level AUC by >= 0.05 over decoder_guard v1 ON BOTH PARTICIPANTS IN THE SAME DIRECTION. A family helping only one is recorded as a null result, not a partial success.
families_closed_list: F3 spectral content of binned activity
what_this_cannot_settle: n = 2, and the two participants disagree. A family clearing +0.05 on both is encouraging and is still n = 2. A third dataset remains worth more.
